title: Access states
statement: Define access states to include read states carrying an access label and a read phase; received-value states carrying an access label and an optional Boolean value; increment states carrying one of four register indices, an access label, and a Boolean value; restore states carrying an optional Boolean value; clear states carrying an optional Boolean value and a Boolean value; bump states carrying a Boolean value; and answer states carrying a Boolean value.
hypotheses_covered: The register index in an increment state is one of four indices.
